In [[mathematics]], the '''generalized Pochhammer symbol''' of parameter <math>\alpha>0</math> and [[partition (number theory)|partition]] <math>\kappa=(\kappa_1,\kappa_2,\ldots,\kappa_m)</math> generalizes the classical [[Pochhammer symbol]], named after [[Leo August Pochhammer]], and is defined as

:<math>(a)^{(\alpha )}_\kappa=\prod_{i=1}^m \prod_{j=1}^{\kappa_i}
\left(a-\frac{i-1}{\alpha}+j-1\right).
</math>
It is used in multivariate [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]].
